trainer.name: Jo & Pat
trainer.dialogueBefore: Jo: Pat and I explore every corner of this cave together. Now battle us together!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Jo: Let's go and explore somewhere a little gentler, Pat.

trainer.name: Jo & Pat
trainer.dialogueBefore: Pat: Wherever Jo goes, I go. Even into battle!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pat: Jo, I followed you straight into a defeat.

trainer.name: Ondrej
trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Dragons are the mightiest Pokémon there are, and mine will prove it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Ondrej: Mighty, yes. Mighty enough, no.

trainer.name: Valencia
trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Valencia: The dark down here sharpens the mind. Can you feel what I'm thinking?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Valencia: All I can feel now is that I've lost.

trainer.name: Henry
trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Henry: I've been pacing up and down here, getting ready for the League. You're just what I need!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Henry: Back to pacing, then.
